title: Development and Validation of a Deep Learning Algorithm to Automatic Detection of Pituitary Microadenoma From MRI.
summary: Methods/Results support two-stage deep-learning MRI detection of pituitary microadenomas with reference diagnosis and retrospective temporal/external testing; claim bounded to diagnostic performance, no clinical benefit inferred. The paper appeared in Frontiers in Medicine. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
